This operational experience demonstrated that an AI- enabled platform can improve the speed, consistency, analytical rigor, and educational value of wargame development and execution. f_Work.docx ===== STATEMENT OF WORK (SOW) RFID Cabinet The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Veterans Health Administration (VHA), requires the acquisition of a Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) storage cabinet integrated with Unique Device Identifier (UDI)-compliant tissue and implant tracking software to support patient safety, regulatory compliance, and efficient inventory management. Tracking tissues, biologics, and implantable medical devices is a federal regulatory requirement under FDA 21 CFR Part 830 (UDI) and is critical to patient safety. VA healthcare facilities face ongoing resource challenges including staff shortages and budget constraints, making it essential to minimize staff time consumed by manual data entry and to maintain precise control over high-value inventory. This acquisition will provide an automated, real-time RFID-based inventory management solution for use in the operating room (OR), Catheterization (Cath) lab, ambulatory surgery center, or any facility location that stores high-value implantable inventory. e medical capabilities, austere mission environments, field hospitals and Forward Operating Bases. DoW’s close relationship with the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) is paramount. The success of an integrated Federal Electronic Health Record (EHR) is a top national priority. Equally critical is the ability to support the continuum of care across operational and enterprise healthcare environments, ensuring that health information generated during military operations can be captured, exchanged, and made available to support continued care within the enterprise health record. Together, these operational, enterprise, and interagency requirements create a highly complex healthcare ecosystem that includes deployed medical environments, fixed medical treatment facilities, the Federal Health Care Center and other DoW/VA sharing sites.
